title: narcissus triandrus subsp. lusitanicus
intro: Narcissus triandrus subsp. lusitanicus, commonly known as the Portuguese narcissus or Lusitanica narcissus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The health benefits of Narcissus triandrus subsp. lusitanicus include its potential to treat various conditions such as respiratory issues, skin infections, and certain types of cancer, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
